statBlock.name: Behir
statBlock.description: A many-legged hunter that clings to steep cavern walls. It swallows smaller prey and drives dragons away from its territory.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Constrict attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage. If the behir has no creature constricted, this also grapples the target (escape DC 16). The target remains Restrained until that grapple ends.
Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 20-ft. line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. A failure deals 66 (12d10) lightning damage and a success halves it.
Swallow. Make one Bite attack against a Medium or smaller target the behir is grappling. A hit also swallows the target and ends the grapple. Inside, the target is Blinded and Restrained, has total cover from outside attacks and effects, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns. The behir can hold only one swallowed creature at a time.
If that creature deals at least 30 damage to the behir in a single turn, the behir makes a DC 14 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On a failure it spits the creature out, and the creature falls Prone within 10 ft. If the behir dies, it stops restraining its captive. The captive can spend 15 ft. of movement to leave the corpse, exiting Prone.

statBlock.name: Bulette
statBlock.description: An armored land shark that tracks footsteps through soil and bursts out beneath its prey.

sections.Traits: Standing Leap. It can long jump up to 30 ft. and high jump up to 15 ft. without a running start.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 30 (4d12 + 4) piercing damage.
Deadly Leap. After jumping at least 15 ft. during its movement, the bulette can use this action to land on its feet in an occupied space. Every other creature in that space makes a DC 16 Strength or Dexterity save, its choice. On a failure it falls Prone and takes 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage. On a success it takes half damage and is pushed 5 ft. out of the bulette's space into an unoccupied space of its choice. If no such space is available, it falls Prone in the bulette's space.

statBlock.name: Dryad
statBlock.description: A woodland fey bound to a living tree. She watches travelers from the grove and defends it alongside other forest creatures.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. She has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Speak with Beasts and Plants. She can communicate with beasts and plants as though they shared a language.
Tree Stride. Once on her turn, she can spend 10 ft. of movement to magically enter a living tree within reach and emerge from another living tree within 60 ft. of the first. Both trees must be Large or bigger. She appears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the second tree.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma, save DC 14. These spells need no material components.
At will. Druidcraft.
3/day each. Entangle, Goodberry.
1/day each. Barkskin, Pass without Trace, Shillelagh.
sections.Actions:
Club. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage. With Shillelagh the attack is +6 to hit and deals 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Fey Charm. Choose a humanoid or beast she can see within 30 ft. If it can see her, it makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is magically Charmed and treats her as a trusted friend worth protecting, interpreting her actions and requests as favorably as possible. It still decides what to do.
The target can save again whenever she or an ally harms it. Any successful save ends the effect and makes the target immune to her Fey Charm for 24 hours. The charm otherwise lasts up to 24 hours, ending early if she dies, is on a different plane from the target, or dismisses it as a bonus action. She can maintain the charm on one humanoid and up to three beasts at once.

statBlock.name: Hippogriff
statBlock.description: A winged, eagle-fronted creature with a horse's hindquarters. A hippogriff raised in captivity can become a loyal mount.

sections.Traits: Keen Sight. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Beak and one Claws attack.
Beak. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

statBlock.name: Pegasus
statBlock.description: A shy, intelligent winged horse from Arborea. A pegasus may choose a good-aligned rider and form a lifelong bond.

sections.Languages: Understands Celestial, Common, Elvish, and Sylvan. It cannot speak.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

statBlock.name: Xorn
statBlock.description: A three-armed earth elemental that eats coins and gems. A hungry xorn may bargain for treasure and offer news of places it has passed underground.

sections.Damage resistances: Piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine.
sections.Traits:
Earth Glide. It can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing it.
Stone Camouflage. It has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.
Treasure Sense. By scent it pinpoints precious metals and stones, including coins and gems, within 60 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Claw attacks and one Bite.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 304. Resistance wording follows the official errata.

statBlock.name: Remorhaz
statBlock.description: An arctic burrower with a furnace-hot body. It cools itself while lying in wait so it can stay hidden under ice and snow.

sections.Traits: Heated Body. A creature takes 10 (3d6) fire damage if it touches the remorhaz or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 40 (6d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage. A creature hit is Grappled (escape DC 17) and Restrained until the grapple ends. During that grapple the remorhaz cannot bite another target.
Swallow. Make one Bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature the remorhaz is grappling. On a hit it takes the Bite damage, is swallowed, and is no longer grappled. Inside, it is Blinded and Restrained, has total cover from attacks and effects outside, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the remorhaz's turns.
If a creature inside deals at least 30 damage to the remorhaz in a single turn, the remorhaz makes a DC 15 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On a failure it spits out every swallowed creature. They fall Prone within 10 ft. If the remorhaz dies, it stops restraining its captives. Each can spend 15 ft. of movement to leave the corpse, exiting Prone.

statBlock.name: Roper
statBlock.description: It looks like a cave formation until its eye opens and its sticky tendrils reach for passing prey.

sections.Traits:
False Appearance. While motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cave formation.
Grasping Tendrils. It can have up to six tendrils at once. Each has AC 20, 10 HP, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. Destroying one leaves the roper unharmed, and it can grow a replacement on its next turn. A creature can also use an action to break a tendril with a successful DC 15 Strength check.
Spider Climb. It climbs difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four Tendril attacks, use Reel, then make one Bite attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Tendril. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 50 ft., one creature. A hit grapples the creature (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the creature is Restrained, has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saves, and occupies that tendril so the roper cannot use it on another target.
Reel. Pull each creature the roper has grappled up to 25 ft. straight toward it.
